    swDesignTable.EditFeature

conflicts.remarks_quote: The two mated items must be selected with a selection mark of 1.
conflicts.example_quote:
'   IAssemblyDoc::EditMate3 requires that mate entities
        '   be selected with mark of 1 except for:
        '       swMateCAMFOLLOWER
        '           cam face              --> 1
        '           cam follower face     --> 8
        '       swMateSYMMETRIC
        '           symmetry faces        --> 1
        '           symmetry plane        --> 4
conflicts.why: Remarks 把 mark=1 写成无条件硬要求；示例明写 cam follower face 用 8、symmetry plane 用 4，两者不可同时成立。

example_more_specific.what: 示例注明配合特征的 mark 被忽略，成员页只要求「必须最后选」未提 mark
example_more_specific.example_quote:
' IAssemblyDoc::EditMate3 requires mate feature to be selected last
    ' Mark is ignored
    bRet = swFeat.Select2(True, 0)

results.note: C#/VB.NET 两份示例逐字重复同一 mark 例外表，三份一致对撞 Remarks

example_more_specific.what: 示例给出配合特征的类型串「MATE」与 mark 0，成员页只说「Mate feature to repair」
example_more_specific.example_quote:
status = swModelDocExt.SelectByID2("Concentric1", "MATE", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0)
    status = swModelDocExt.SelectByID2("", "FACE", -5.62994754449733E-02, -7.69308980977712E-04, 8.1518960735707E-03, True, 1, Nothing, 0)

results.note: Remarks 的选择顺序与两个 mark=1 在三份示例中完全对上，未见冲突

bRet = swMoldBaseComp.Select2(False, 0)
    nRetval = swAssy.EditPart2(True, True, nInfo)

example_more_specific.what: 另一示例传 AllowReadOnly=False，并断言返回值等于 swEditPartSuccessful
example_more_specific.example_quote:
' Start in-context edit
    nRetVal = swAssy.EditPart2(True, False, nInfo)
    Debug.Assert swEditPartSuccessful = nRetVal
